verdict_reason: Present PE 24.4 sits well below both 10yr Shiller PE (51.4) and own historical median (44.2), close to the historically-cheap end of its range.
devils_advocate: The FY082-83 EPS (13.76) is annualized off an unaudited Q3 YTD figure driven by the new 40MW Upper Chameliya plant ramping up — hydro generation is seasonal (dry-season Q4 output typically weaker), so full-year EPS may land below the naive annualization, making the 'cheap' present PE partly an artifact of extrapolating a strong wet-season quarter. Also the historical PE band includes construction-phase years (069-072) with near-zero/negative EPS that distort what 'cheap vs history' even means for this stock.
